sources.entry: Kyapchar - Simple screen and microphone audio recorder for Mac. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/vishaltelangre/Kyapchar) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]
Kyapchar - Simple screen and microphone audio recorder for macOS.

summary.one_liner: Kyapchar is a simple Mac menu-bar app for recording screen and microphone audio.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Kyapchar as a simple screen and microphone audio recorder for Mac that stays in the toolbar. It is distributed as a zip download from the releases page, which is extracted and the Kypachar.app moved into the Applications folder. The README includes a GIF preview but no written feature list. Development instructions say to open Kyapchar.xcodeproj in Xcode and build and run with cmd+R. Copyright is held by Vishal Telangre, 2016-18. The README does not describe recording options, output formats, or settings.
use_cases: record my screen on a Mac
capture microphone audio with screen video
simple screen recording from the menu bar
make a quick screen capture with voice narration
build and modify a macOS recorder app in Xcode
how_to_run: Download the latest zip file from the releases page
Move Kypachar.app into the Applications folder
Press cmd (⌘) + R to build and run
stack: Swift or Objective-C (Xcode project; language not named in README)
notable: Lives in the Mac toolbar as a simple recorder
Records screen and microphone audio together
Distributed as a prebuilt app via releases zip
Open-source with an Xcode project for building from source
caveats: README is brief and does not list features, system requirements, or supported macOS versions
Built with Xcode, so building from source requires Xcode on a Mac
Copyright notice dates to 2016-18, so maintenance status is unclear
